# toDecorationStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`DecorationStyleInput`](decoration-style-input.md) to the [`DecorationStyle`](decoration-style.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toDecorationStyle(input: DecorationStyleToken | DecorationStyle): DecorationStyle
```
